messages.subject: [IT] Scheduled DMS maintenance - Saturday 22 November, 8am-12pm
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear colleagues,

The firm's document management system (NetDocs) will be unavailable this Saturday 22 November between 8am and 12pm for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please save and close all documents before Friday evening. Email and calendar are unaffected. Contact the helpdesk on x4000 if you have any concerns.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
